facts.value: The Unibator acts as an 'incubator for innovation' at Goethe University. It supports students, staff, and alumni from all disciplines in transforming scientific findings and emerging business ideas into market-ready products and services. Founders undergo an 18-month startup program aimed at developing a validated and scalable business model.
The AndersGründer project in the Social Impact Lab Frankfurt supports startups in founding their social enterprises, providing coaching, qualification, co-working, and access to relevant networks.
Universities in the FrankfurtRheinMain region are consolidating their activities and launching a central internet portal to support startup initiatives from the academic environment.

Information on suitable offerings for interested students, early-stage startups, or growing startups, including incubators, accelerators, funding program consulting, cooperation offerings with external partners from business and science, competitions, and startup awards.
Offers for interdisciplinary and inter-university team formation are available.
